newsitem.title: INDIA: At least 15 killed in Indian bus accident--agency.
newsitem.headline: At least 15 killed in Indian bus accident--agency.

text.p: At least 15 people were killed and 25 injured, when a bus rammed into a truck in the northern Indian state of Uttar Pradesh, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said on Sunday.
The collision took place near Allahabad, about 600 km (375 miles) south-east of the Indian capital, the news agency reported.
The injured, some of whom were in critical condition, had been admitted to a local hospital, the PTI said.
